name: Maha Jwarankusha Rasa

sections.reference_basavarajeeyam_jwara_prakarana: Maha Jwarankusha Rasa is an Ayurvedic medicine in tablet form. It is used in the treatment of fever. This medicine contains heavy metal ingredients, hence should only be taken under strict medical supervision. It balances Vata and Pitta.
sections.ingredients_and_method_of_preparation:
10 g fine powder of each of:- 

 Shuddha Parada – Herbal purified Mercury 
 Shuddha Gandhaka – Herbal purified Sulphur 
 Tamra Bhasma – Bhasma prepared from Copper 
 Shuddha Hingula – Purified and processed Cinnabar (Mercury compound) 
 Shuddha Haratala – Purified and processed Orpiment (Arsenic trisulphide) 
 Loha Bhasma – Bhasma prepared from Iron 
 Vanga Bhasma – Tin Calx 
 Makshika Bhasma – Bhasma of Copper-Iron Pyrite 
 Kharpara Bhasma – Bhasma (Calx) of Zinc Sulphide 
 Manashila – Purified and processed Realgar (Arsenic di sulphide) 
 Abhrak Bhasma – Purified and processed Mica 
 Gairika – Purified and processed Red Ochre 
 Tankana Bhasma – Borax 
 Shuddha Jayapala – Croton tiglium 

 Juice extract, quantity sufficient of each of following for grinding for 3 days each:- 

 Nimbu – lemon juice 
 Tulasi – Holy Basil – Ocimum sanctum 
 Chitraka – Lead Wort (root) – Plumbago zeylanica 
 VIjaya – Bhang – C annabis sativa 
 Chincha – Tamarind – Tamarindus indica – leaves 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Maha Jwarankusha Rasa is an efficient Ayurvedic formulation which has ability to maintain the Vata and Pitta balance in the body, possessing anti-pyretic, antimicrobial activity which helps to bring healing effect in various health related conditions. 
 This Ayurvedic medicine is very effective in managing every kind of fever, chronic fever, intermittent fever etc., it is good to improve immunity of the body, lowers and maintain the normal body temperature, hence helps to regain strength in the body, relieving fatigue and weakness in the body. 
 It is also very beneficial to deal with problems related to digestion. It is helpful in improving the digestive power, and provides relief from vomiting and nausea. It is even suitable to reduce flatulence, eliminates the gas trouble.
sections.indications:
Fever 
 Chronic fever 
 Intermittent fever 
 Improves digestion power
sections.dosage: Take 125 mg once or twice a day, before or after food or as directed by an Ayurvedic doctor. It is advised along with honey, warm water.
sections.side_effects:
Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous as it contains heavy metal ingredients. 
 Take this medicine in precise doses and for a limited period of time, as advised by the doctor. 
 Overdose may cause severe poisonous 
 This medicine should be avoided in pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 
 Store in a dry cool place. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Maha Jwarankusha Rasa 
 Reference: Basavarajeeyam, Jwara Prakarana 
 Maha Jwarankusha Rasa is an Ayurvedic medicine in tablet form. It is used in the treatment of fever. This medicine contains heavy metal ingredients, hence should only be taken under strict medical supervision. It balances Vata and Pitta. 
 Ingredients and method of preparation 
 10 g fine powder of each of:- 
 
 Shuddha Parada – Herbal purified Mercury 
 Shuddha Gandhaka – Herbal purified Sulphur 
 Tamra Bhasma – Bhasma prepared from Copper 
 Shuddha Hingula – Purified and processed Cinnabar (Mercury compound) 
 Shuddha Haratala – Purified and processed Orpiment (Arsenic trisulphide)

 Gairika – Purified and processed Red Ochre 
 Tankana Bhasma – Borax 
 Shuddha Jayapala – Croton tiglium 
 
 Juice extract, quantity sufficient of each of following for grinding for 3 days each:- 
 
 Nimbu – lemon juice 
 Tulasi – Holy Basil – Ocimum sanctum 
 Chitraka – Lead Wort (root) – Plumbago zeylanica 
 VIjaya – Bhang – C annabis sativa 
 Chincha – Tamarind – Tamarindus indica – leaves 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Maha Jwarankusha Rasa is an efficient Ayurvedic formulation which has ability to maintain the Vata and Pitta balance in the body, possessing anti-pyretic, antimicrobial activity which helps to bring healing effect in various health related conditions. 
 This Ayurvedic medicine is very effective in managing every kind of fever, chronic fever, intermittent fever etc., it is good to improve immunity of the body, lowers and maintain the normal body temperature, hence helps to regain strength in the body, relieving fatigue and weakness in the body. 
 It is also very beneficial to deal with problems related to digestion. It is helpful in improving the digestive power, and provides relief from vomiting and nausea. It is even suitable to reduce flatulence, eliminates the gas trouble. 
 Indications 
 
 Fever 
 Chronic fever 
 Intermittent fever 
 Improves digestion power 
 
 Dosage 
 Take 125 mg once or twice a day, before or after food or as directed by an Ayurvedic doctor. It is advised along with honey, warm water. 
 Side effects 
 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous as it contains heavy metal ingredients. 
 Take this medicine in precise doses and for a limited period of time, as advised by the doctor.

 This medicine should be avoided in pregnancy, lactation and in children.

 Store in a dry cool place. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
